verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a risk register populated from a NIST-based risk library, with inherent and residual risk scoring and treatment plans generated by Comply AI for Risk. Risks are also exposed as manageable objects via the MCP server. The rest of the story is unevidenced, so this is roughly half of what was asked. Missing for 10: risk owner assignment, recurring risk review cycles, explicit risk-to-control mapping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
